title: Otakon 2026 Hosts Voice Actress Ayaka Fukuhara, I.G. USA's President Maki Terashima-Furuta
content: The staff of Otakon announced on Sunday it will host voice actress Ayaka Fukuhara ( Captain Tsubasa , Sakura Wars ) and president of Production I.G. USA Maki Terashima-Furuta , at this year's event.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Reveals Episode 1 Opening Video Featuring OP Song by Yuiko Ohara
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 1 opening video featuring the theme song by Yuiko Ohara. Crunchyroll will be streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: My Girlfriend's Friend TV Anime Reveals Teaser Video, More Staff Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Jura's My Girlfriend's Friend ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) manga revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, second key visual, and additional staff members on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Shinya Komi's Sora o Matotte Manga Ends on July 15
content: Manga creator Shinya Komi revealed on July 2 that the Sora o Matotte (To Drape Over the Sky) manga will end in the next issue of Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine on July 15. The manga centers on high school student Haro Ogawa.
author: ANN

title: 29 Years Later, One Piece Finally Settles The Zoro vs Sanji Debate
content: The highly anticipated Elbaph Arc in One Piece takes a turn for the worse with the unexpected arrival of the Holy Knights . Luffy and his crew were welcomed warmly in the fabled Land of the Giants, but the celebration didn’t last long after the villains showed up and targeted the children.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata Series Gets 2nd Season
content: Tokyo MX announced on Sunday that it is producing a second season for the live-action series of Ogeretsu Tanaka 's Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata (The Right Way to Write Love) boys-love manga that will debut on Tokyo MX1 in October.
author: ANN

title: 12 Years Later, It’s About to Be Harder Than Ever to Watch a Controversial Dark Fantasy
content: The Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, and Crunchyroll isn’t the only platform making major plans for new releases. With the anime industry exponentially growing in popularity, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say it has long become one of the mainstream forms of media across the globe.
author: ComicBook

title: emaqi Launches Monthly Subscription Service
content: AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Wednesday it is launching a monthly subscription service called " emaqi Premium" for its e-bookstore service " emaqi ." The subscription costs US$6.99 (CAD$9.99) monthly and launched on the app on the same day.
author: ANN

title: October 2027 Is Going to Be Huge for Fantasy Anime Fans
content: As a genre, fantasy has always held an enduring power to enchant audiences. It has also been a cornerstone in Japanese storytelling, easily making its way into the anime and manga medium.
